summary: Inline GeoJSON geometry for a zone (alternative to geofence_id).
range: Object: { type (Polygon|MultiPolygon), coordinates }. coordinates use [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON order — the one lon/lat exception).
businessRules: geometry defines: It is a [geoJSON object](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7946#page-9) with details of the geographic boundaries of the zone. Only “Polygon” and “MultiPolygon” geoJSON types are supported. …
Must stay consistent with: zones.geometry.type, zones.geometry.coordinates. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Negative: an unclosed ring / wrong type -> 400.
